label: Architecture: Cycles render → photoreal → 4× upscale (Qwen edit + PiD)
description: Architecture AI render: a Cycles render of the camera view made photoreal by Qwen Image 2.1 edit (keeps the blocked geometry almost pixel for pixel), then PiD ×4 (7616×4320). The prompt names each surface and its material: edit it, or let an agent fill it from SAM3 (blender_segment). Viewer shows the render, Save keeps the upscale.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.label: Surfaces & materials
nodes.text: Turn <image1>, a 3D render, into a real photograph. Photorealistic interior photograph of a modern living room, architectural photography, natural daylight through the window, soft realistic shadows. The wall is smooth warm-white lime plaster. The ceiling is flat white plaster. The floor is wide-plank light oak parquet with a satin finish. The rug is a cream hand-woven wool rug. The shelf is a walnut bookcase with books and ceramics. The window is a black steel-framed glazing looking onto a sunny garden. The sofa is a light grey linen sofa with cushions. The table is a dark walnut coffee table. The door is a solid walnut door. The lamp is a matte black metal pendant lamp. Keep the exact layout, camera, perspective and proportions of the room.
